name: Aequs Ltd
about: Founded in 2000, Aequs focuses on high-precision, high-complexity components and assemblies for global OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers, especially in civil aviation. [1]

flags.text: Debtor days rose from 48 to 78 in three years: customers are taking longer to pay
Cash conversion cycle stretched from 146 to 290 days in three years
Share capital up 58% in three years: new shares from an issue, a merger or a bonus. Only the first two dilute

business.what: Aequs Limited is a manufacturing company providing integrated solutions across aerospace and consumer sectors. It operates through an ecosystem model, delivering complex components and products for global customers through engineering, machining, and assembly capabilities.

segments.name: Aerospace
segments.comment: Delivered strong growth and profitability, supported by healthy demand and consistent program execution.

segments.name: Consumer
segments.comment: Volume ramp-up was slower than anticipated due to learning curves and supply chain constraints.

ledger.promise: Aerospace segment revenue growth of 25% to 30% in FY27
ledger.quote: We have the order book, the capacity and the customer relationships to support this, which should deliver 25% to 30% revenue growth, with EBITDA margins maintained at 20% at the segment level.
ledger.actual: Segment-specific revenue figures are not disclosed in reported financials to verify aerospace segment growth.

ledger.promise: Consolidated top-line revenue growth of 45% to 50% in FY27
ledger.quote: At a consolidated level, we are expecting approximately 45% to 50% top -line revenue growth.
ledger.actual: H1 FY27 consolidated revenue reached Rs 805 crore (Q1: Rs 396 cr, Q2: Rs 409 cr), compared to FY26 revenue of Rs 1,230 crore.

ledger.promise: Maintain consolidated EBITDA margins in 20% plus range
ledger.quote: For the nine months, our margins have been 24 % and we continue to see the margin range in 20% plus range.
ledger.actual: Consolidated EBITDA margins fell to 1.1% in Q4 FY26, 3.8% in Q1 FY27, and 3.4% in Q2 FY27.

ledger.promise: Consumer EBITDA break-even by Q4 FY27
ledger.quote: Third, move our consumer EBITDA to break even by Q4 FY27, which will be a major inflection point for our consolidated profitability.
ledger.actual: Target deadline is Q4 FY27. Management reported Q2 FY27 volume ramp delays due to qualification and supply chain bottlenecks.

ledger.promise: Consolidated PAT break-even by H1 FY28
ledger.quote: we fully expect to see consolidated PAT hit break-even by H1 FY28.
ledger.actual: Target deadline is H1 FY28. Consolidated PAT posted losses of Rs -53 crore in Q1 FY27 and Rs -52 crore in Q2 FY27.

ledger.promise: Total capex of INR 660 crores for FY27
ledger.quote: our total capex overall including aero and consumer would be about INR660 crores for FY27.
ledger.actual: FY27 is ongoing; full year cash flows from investing activities have not yet been reported.

ledger.promise: Doubling of operational EBITDA in FY27
ledger.quote: with the doubling of our operational EBITDA, a target that is weighted to the second half as consumer utilization builds through the year.
ledger.actual: FY26 EBITDA was Rs 92 crore. H1 FY27 generated Rs 29 crore, with guidance heavily weighted to H2 FY27.

ledger.promise: Commencement of Hosur aerospace facility in H2 FY27 to FY28
ledger.quote: The first facility will commence in the second half between September to March timeframe of next year of FY27 to FY28
ledger.actual: Timeline delayed in Q2 FY27 call: investment starts Q4 FY27 and commercial production commences in FY29.

ledger.quote: I think we'll end up maintaining as we have guided about 120 days is what we want to shoot at
ledger.actual: Reported inventory days stood at 420 days in FY25 and 450 days in FY26, substantially higher than guided.

current_guidance.quote: We are not deterring away from the 4 to 6x the guidance of 2031.
See, first is coming to the consumer utilization, we still are targeting 40% to 50%. So that still remains there.
On our indicative roadmap, the first phase of investment begins with Q4 FY '27 and commercial production will start in FY '29.
Look, we have already guided it is going to be FY '30 when we are PAT positive from consumer.
I think we'll end up maintaining as we have guided about 120 days is what we want to shoot at

credibility.label: low
credibility.summary: Management has repeatedly missed margin guidance, with EBITDA margins collapsing from 10%+ levels down to 3.4% in Q2 FY27 against target ranges of 18-22%. Working capital control is poor with inventory days ballooning to 450 days, and facility commissioning timelines have been pushed back.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management guided in Q3 FY26 to maintain EBITDA margins in the 20% plus range.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Consolidated EBITDA margin collapsed to 1.1% in Q4 FY26, 3.8% in Q1 FY27, and 3.4% in Q2 FY27.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management target for inventory days is around 120 days.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Inventory days increased from 336 days in FY24 to 420 days in FY25 and 450 days in FY26.

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management expected 45% to 50% top-line growth in FY27.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Consolidated revenue reached Rs 396 crore in Q1 FY27 and Rs 409 crore in Q2 FY27 (H1 total Rs 805 crore vs FY26 full year Rs 1,230 crore).

narrative_vs_numbers.story: Management attributed consumer segment EBITDA losses to ramp-up expenses and capacity additions.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers: Consolidated quarterly PAT losses widened to Rs -54 crore in Q4 FY26, Rs -53 crore in Q1 FY27, and Rs -52 crore in Q2 FY27.

bull.point: Robust top-line revenue trajectory expanding quarterly.
bull.evidence: Quarterly revenue expanded from Rs 256 crore in Q1 FY26 to Rs 409 crore in Q2 FY27.

bull.point: Long-term revenue scale guidance of 4x to 6x growth by 2031 remains intact.
bull.evidence: Management reiterated adherence to the 4x to 6x revenue growth target by 2031.

bull.point: Capacity utilization target in consumer business maintained despite short-term ramp delays.
bull.evidence: Management reiterated target consumer business utilization of 40% to 50% by year end.

bear.point: Severe margin compression and deepening net losses.
bear.evidence: EBITDA margins dropped to 3.4% in Q2 FY27, with TTM PAT loss expanding to Rs -202 crore.
Inventory days stretched from 313 in FY23 to 450 in FY26, far above the guided 120-day target.

bear.point: Key customer loss and project execution delays.
bear.evidence: Hasbro stopped issuing POs, and commercial production at Hosur facility was delayed to FY29.
